definition: Team Elo minus opponent Elo, divided by 100. Analyst-computed ratings, initial 1500, K=20, home adjustment 100, from all archived matches before this date.
Team win fraction minus opponent win fraction, each over the latest 10 prior internationals.
Team draw fraction minus opponent draw fraction over the latest 10 prior internationals.
Difference in calendar days since each side last played, each capped at 14. Source dates are used; this is not exact recovery hours.
1 if team is playing in its own country; -1 if the opponent is; otherwise 0. FIFA first-listed team is not assumed to be the home side.
log(1 + team prior World Cup finals matches) minus log(1 + opponent prior finals matches), including earlier 2026 matches.
Sum of result signs from the team perspective in the latest five prior meetings, divided by number of meetings + 2. No previous meeting gives 0; shootout outcomes are draws.
Difference in fractions of last 10 internationals whose source tournament is not Friendly.
Fraction of the team's last 10 internationals whose source tournament is not Friendly. Shared concept with competitive_share_difference.
Mean team goals scored across its last 10 prior internationals, including extra time and excluding shootout kicks.
Mean goals conceded by the opponent across its last 10 prior internationals.
Fraction of team's last 10 prior internationals in which it scored zero goals.
Fraction of opponent's last 10 prior internationals in which it conceded zero goals.
